pipeline_trace_mechanism.wired_in: providers/deriv_provider.py (candle history requests emit a trace per request)

r75_specific_aggregation.mechanism: providers/multi_timeframe.py:get_multi_timeframe_context resamples M5/M15/H1 from a single M1 source for provider=='deriv' and asset_class=='derived_index' (the R_75 golden path), rather than fetching each timeframe independently — this makes cross-timeframe consistency structural rather than best-effort.
r75_specific_aggregation.resample_function: providers/multi_timeframe.py:_resample_completed (label='left', closed='left', drops any bucket whose period has not fully elapsed relative to the latest M1 candle)
r75_specific_aggregation.new_test_coverage: tests/test_phase2_r75_aggregation.py (5 tests: M15 exactness, H1 exactness, forming-bucket exclusion, determinism, out-of-order/duplicate M1 normalization)

note: The trace/aggregation infrastructure and its test coverage predate Phase 2 and were verified, not newly built. Genuinely new work: tests/test_phase2_r75_aggregation.py, which had no prior direct coverage of _resample_completed (the M1-source resampling path R_75 specifically uses).
